name: Aloo Palak
description: Simple Pakistani aloo palak with potatoes and spinach cooked with garlic, cumin, tomatoes and green chilies.
ingredients: 500 g fresh spinach, washed and chopped
method: Heat oil and fry cumin seeds, garlic and onion until fragrant.
Add tomatoes, green chilies and powdered spices and cook until soft.
Add the potatoes with a small splash of water, cover and cook until almost tender.
Add chopped spinach and cook uncovered until it wilts and releases moisture.
Continue cooking until the potatoes are tender and excess liquid evaporates.
Taste for salt and serve hot with roti or paratha.
